newsitem.title: USA: Monsanto offers to buy rest of Calgene. [CORRECTED 00:02 GMT 29/1]
newsitem.headline: Monsanto offers to buy rest of Calgene. [CORRECTED 00:02 GMT 29/1]

text.p: Monsanto Co said Tuesday it has made a proposal to the board of directors of Calgene Inc to acquire the remaining shares outstanding of the company for $7.25 a share.
Monsanto currently owns 54.6 percent of the outstanding shares of the Davis, California-based biotechnology interest.

Calgene has about 66.25 million shares and the offer for the remaining shares would amount to just over $217 million, Monsanto said. (Corrects number of shares outstanding and the value of the offer.)
The proposal is subject to the approval of a special committee of the disinterested directors of Calgene's board, Monsanto said.
Calgene said a spokesperson would not be available to respond to questions regarding the offer until Wednesday.
Calgene shares were up 9/16 at 5-1/2 Tuesday.
Shares of Monsanto, an agricultural, pharmaceutical and food ingredients company, rose 1-1/4 to 37-7/8 Tuesday.
